purpose: FlahaX logo and banner concepts based on water, plant nutrition, chemistry and traceable plans.

logo.prompt: Create a polished new brand logo for FlahaX, an open-source scientific plant-nutrient chemistry engine. Deliver ONE horizontal logo lockup on a genuinely transparent background, generous clear space, high resolution. On the left a distinctive simple geometric symbol merging a water droplet and a young leaf, with three subtle connected circular molecular nodes integrated into the leaf's vein. On the right the exact word "FlahaX", capital F and capital X, professionally kerned modern humanist sans serif, highly legible, dark forest green #174d36, with the X in medium green #1f6b45. Symbol palette forest green #1f6b45, fresh sage #8fdcae, tiny restrained aqua accent. Flat vector-like precision, minimal solid geometry, memorable silhouette that works small. Scientific, calm, credible, agricultural, sophisticated. The symbol communicates water + plant nutrition + chemistry; no seal, no certification checkmarks, no claims of validated accuracy. No tagline, no other text, no mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no decorative background. This is a finished logo asset, not a presentation board.

banner.prompt: Create a premium wide landscape website banner for FlahaX, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, high resolution. Use the supplied logo image as a brand reference: faithfully reproduce its leaf/water-drop/molecular-node symbol and "FlahaX" wordmark, readable dark forest green on a very pale ivory mint background. Large logo upper left with ample whitespace. Below it one exact tagline in elegant readable sans-serif: "From water and nutrients to traceable plans." No other text except the small exact labels specified below. Right two-thirds and bottom form one restrained editorial scientific illustration: at left a translucent water-analysis vessel and a small crop leaf with nutrient dots feed two fine aqua/green lines into a central transparent chemistry vessel containing abstract ion pairs; near it a subtle pH curve and tiny crystal motif represent calculation of pH and precipitation. Lines continue to two minimalist stock reservoirs labelled "A" and "B", then thin injector tubing toward a healthy young plant at far right. Beneath the flow, a slim abstract structured record with three clearly printed labels "Units", "Model", "Sources" represents auditable reproducible output, connected to the chemistry calculation by a fine line. Visually conceptual, not an engineering schematic or operational mixing instructions. Balanced composition, plenty of negative space, refined flat vector-like forms with gentle translucent glass effects, forest green #1f6b45, sage #8fdcae, pale aqua, warm ivory. Warm credible scientific software identity, exceptional typographic hierarchy. No fake equations, no invented measurement numbers, no certification badges or checkmarks, no photographic lab, no robotic equipment, no busy dashboard, no additional slogans. All elements comfortably inside canvas with 5 percent safe margins. A finished usable banner, not a mockup or branding board.

note: Conceptual branding artwork, not an engineering schematic or scientific validation. Existing live branding has not been replaced.
